_meta.description: Curated key verses from Lamentations (great is your faithfulness; new mercies every morning; the Lord is good to those who wait). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing

verses.text: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.plain: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

verses.text: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.plain: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

verses.text: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.plain: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him.
